source_row.rationale: ARUP Consult describes ESR as a nonspecific inflammatory marker. An elevated ESR can support generalized inflammation but is not diagnostic of a particular disease or etiology without clinical context and additional evaluation.
source_row.source_detail: Section ‘Erythrocyte Sedimentation Rate (ESR)’ and overview noting ESR/CRP are nonspecific and not diagnostic for a particular condition.
